chronology: This declaration must precede both source-birth implementations and all prospective source construction. Preserve Git commit-parent chronology.

U.shape: 16-bit bijection; 4 independently keyed 4-bit permutation boxes; nibble-position permutation and invertible reversible mixing through three variable-depth layers; no Feistel family tags to learner.
U.source_origin: Separate source-only Git birth commit; U recipe and provider tree identity must be pinned before any registered source is generated.

R.shape: Independent 16-bit nonlinear reversible word-graph composition using alternating odd-modular multiplication and word rotations/XOR feedback with heterogeneous graph depth; no per-family oracle or task tags to learner.
R.source_origin: Separate source-only Git birth commit after U, immutable independent file and different algorithmic grammar; must be independently witnessed before first-use.

frozen_controls: unchanged F124-AZ learned joint-public inverse at pinned immutable blob
eligible exact symbolic composition subject to identical whole-task CPU and memory accounting
random-48 vs balanced-48 public observations matched without leakage
memorization and operator-tag lookup ablations are disqualifying shortcuts, not eligible candidates

scientific_acceptance.primary: Per-cohort paired improvement >=8/128 relative to strongest fully budget-eligible frozen comparator, no pooled-only rescue.
scientific_acceptance.replication: Two independently born source families must both pass without tuning between cohorts; no shared held-out source selection.

resource_accounting.scope: Task inputs/public pair storage, 192 TRAIN-task model-prior work, model parameters and weights, 40 FIT/8 CHECK, representation transitions, graph scoring, evaluator-visible runtime overhead where comparable, and all intermediate/peak memory.
resource_accounting.compare: candidate <= original F124-AZ complete CPU time and whole-task peak resident memory AND any eligible stronger matched full-information public control; training cost amortized over exactly 128 U tasks and separately 128 R tasks; report raw totals too.
resource_accounting.nonsemantic_gpu_or_host_variation: Same runner, toolchain, workload and accounting harness; calibrated repeats; no fake parity from Python model bytes or synthetic-only measurements.

evidence_requirements.independent_provenance: Exact Git tree/blob and commit chronology, source generation independent of learner implementation, witnessed birth before prospective first use, no reuse of consumed F124 cohorts. Self-attestation alone is insufficient for independently authenticated source birth.
evidence_requirements.candidate_freeze: Exact model source/blob, policy, toolchain, budgets, comparator, acceptance and source identity before any registered first-use.
evidence_requirements.outputs: Nonconsuming readiness manifest, per-frozen-identity source commitments, ledger schema with null unobserved values, SHA256 custody and fail-closed state.
